code.evidence: Our first-principles calculations were performed within the framework of density functional theory with a plane wave basis set as implemented in the Vienna ab initio simulation package (VASP)

code_version.evidence: Our first-principles calculations were performed within the framework of density functional theory with a plane wave basis set as implemented in the Vienna ab initio simulation package (VASP)48,49

xc_functional.evidence: The exchange and correlation energy was described by the generalized gradient approximation with Perdew, Burke, and Ernzerhof (PBE) parameterization50

pseudopotential_type.evidence: The projector augmented-wave (PAW) method was used49

k_mesh.evidence: The Monckhorst-Pack k-mesh of 15 ×​ 15 ×​ 1 was applied to sample k points in the first Brillouin zone for integrating electronic properties51

force_threshold_ev_ang.evidence: All the atoms were fully relaxed with force converge up to 0.02 eV/Å

energy_threshold_ev.evidence: The calculated total energy was converged to 10−5 eV

plane_wave_cutoff_ev.evidence: The cutoff energy for plane-wave basis set was chosen to be 400 eV

vacuum_spacing_ang.evidence: The nanostructure of penta-BxNy was placed in xy plane of the supercell with a 15 Å vacuum in z direction

elastic_units_reported.evidence: The elastic constants C11, C22, C12, and C66 are in the unit of N/m

parameters.reasoning: The paper uses plane-wave DFT with PBE functional, a 15x15x1 k-grid, 400 eV plane-wave cutoff, and PAW pseudopotentials. SIESTA uses NAO basis, so plane-wave parameters have no direct equivalent. The paper states a 15x15x1 k-grid for 2D system, so vacuum axis must have exactly 1 division. The paper does not report mesh_cutoff_ry (real-space grid), so we choose 300 Ry for light elements. Basis size is assumed to be DZP as standard for production. XC functional is mapped to GGA/PBE since SIESTA cannot do hybrid/meta-GGA. The paper states vacuum spacing of 15 Å, so we use 15.0 for SIESTA's vacuum spacing.
unmapped: the paper's plane-wave cutoff (400 eV) has no NAO equivalent, so a mesh cutoff of 300 Ry was chosen independently
the paper's basis_size (not reported) has no equivalent in SIESTA's NAO basis, so DZP was assumed as standard for production
the paper's plane_wave_cutoff_ev (400 eV) has no equivalent in SIESTA's NAO basis, so mesh_cutoff_ry was set to 300 Ry independently
the paper's smearing (not reported) has no equivalent in SIESTA's NAO basis, so default smearing was used
the paper's spin_polarised (not reported) has no equivalent in SIESTA's NAO basis, so default spin polarization was used
